job.title: Construction Project Coordinator
job.description:
Our client is seeking a motivated Project Coordinator to join their Canberra team.

This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of projects across the construction lifecycle, coordinating everything from design and engineering through to manufacturing, delivery and onsite installation.

Working closely with builders, designers, engineers, factory personnel and installation teams, you'll play a central role in ensuring projects run smoothly, deadlines are met and clients receive a high level of service.
Whether you have previous experience in construction coordination or are looking to take the next step in your career, this role offers the opportunity to develop your technical knowledge and build a long-term career within an established business.

The Role
You'll be responsible for coordinating multiple projects simultaneously, acting as the central point of contact between internal teams and external stakeholders.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Project Coordination: Manage projects from contract acceptance through to practical completion, maintaining schedules and tracking key milestones.
  • Design & Engineering: Coordinate design and detailing workflows, manage drawing revisions, follow up RFIs and ensure the latest approved documentation is available.
  • Manufacturing: Work alongside the factory team to coordinate production schedules, priorities and manufacturing requirements.
  • Delivery & Logistics: Organise transport, delivery schedules, site access, unloading arrangements and crane requirements.
  • Installation: Coordinate installation crews, mobilisation dates, site readiness and onsite progress.
  • Client Management: Maintain regular communication with builders, clients and internal stakeholders, providing project updates and following up outstanding information.
  • Cost & Variations: Identify scope changes, coordinate variation requests and assist with monitoring project costs.
  • Reporting & Documentation: Maintain project trackers, schedules, drawing registers, approval logs and progress reports.
About You
We're looking for someone who is proactive, exceptionally organised and enjoys working in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.
You'll ideally have:
  • Previous experience in project coordination, project administration or a similar role.
  • Exposure to the construction, manufacturing or building products industry.
  • The ability to read and interpret architectural and construction drawings.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Strong attention to detail and confidence using Microsoft Excel, Outlook and project tracking systems.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and following up outstanding actions.
Experience with light gauge steel, timber frame and truss manufacturing, structural drawings, BIM models or prefabricated construction would be highly regarded.

A qualification in civil or structural engineering, architecture or construction would also be advantageous.

What's on Offer?
  • Salary package of $85,000 = $100k + Super, depending on experience.
  • Full training provided, including training on the company's software and systems.
  • A progressive career path with opportunities to explore different areas of the wider group business.
  • Exposure to the full project lifecycle, developing both technical and commercial construction knowledge.
  • The opportunity to join an established specialist business and make a genuine contribution to its project delivery operations.
#SCR-sophie-potts

job.title: Automation Technician
job.description:
Industrial Automation Technologist / Technician

Location: Wetherill Park, Sydney
Industry: Advanced Manufacturing (Injection Moulding & Automation) Employment Type: Full-time, 24/7 manufacturing environment

About the Role
Our client, an established manufacturing operation based in Wetherill Park, is seeking an experienced Industrial Automation Technologist/Technician to join their team. This is a hands-on, technically diverse role supporting PLC-driven automation, industrial robotics, injection moulding machinery, and high-speed production equipment across a 24/7 site.

You'll be a key technical point of contact for production issues relating to equipment performance, product quality, and efficiency — working closely with Production, Maintenance, and Quality teams to minimise downtime and maximise OEE.
This role blends fault-finding, preventative maintenance, die setting, process optimisation, and continuous improvement, with genuine exposure to automation upgrades and manufacturing improvement projects.

Key Responsibilities
Automation & Technical Maintenance
  • Troubleshoot and maintain industrial automation and production equipment across a 24/7 environment
  • Service, repair, and set up injection moulding machines, industrial robots, IML systems, and auxiliary equipment
  • Fault-find and replace mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic components
  • Integrate industrial robots into material handling, inspection, and packaging applications, including safety interlock verification
  • Perform preventative and predictive maintenance, equipment upgrades, and calibrations
  • Complete major equipment overhauls and support complex machine, processing, and die-setting issues
Production & Process Support
  • Act as a key technical contact for production issues affecting output, quality, reliability, and efficiency
  • Perform die, insert, and colour changes, including machine start-ups and shutdowns
  • Set, adjust, and optimise robotics, machine software, and production process parameters
  • Troubleshoot production faults, including IML and high-speed packaging equipment
  • Maintain target cycle times while ensuring finished products meet specification
Continuous Improvement & Problem Solving
  • Investigate recurring and new faults using structured root-cause analysis; implement corrective and preventative actions
  • Analyse downtime, rejects, defects, and waste to identify improvement opportunities
  • Support automation design, programming, commissioning, and equipment upgrades
  • Maintain accurate records of downtime, rejects, NCRs, maintenance activities, and corrective actions
Quality & Compliance
  • Work closely with Quality Assurance to ensure equipment and processes meet product, customer, and regulatory requirements
  • Ensure compliance with site quality systems, HACCP, and applicable food safety requirements
  • Verify new or modified automation systems before production handover
Safety & Team Support
  • Work in line with WHS legislation, site safety procedures, and permit requirements
  • Identify, report, and rectify hazards and near misses
  • Coordinate with third-party service technicians when required
  • Support training and technical upskilling of production and maintenance personnel
  • Communicate and escalate technical issues across shifts to maintain operational continuity
About You
  • Proven experience in industrial automation, robotics, and/or injection moulding within a manufacturing environment
  • Strong mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic fault-finding skills
  • Experience with PLC-driven systems and industrial robot integration
  • Die-setting experience highly regarded
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, 24/7 production environment
  • Strong root-cause analysis and continuous improvement mindset
  • Food safety/HACCP exposure an advantage
  • Ability to train and support colleagues, and communicate effectively across shifts
Why Apply
  • Stable, full-time opportunity with genuine exposure to modern automation technology
  • Hands-on role combining automation, robotics, and process engineering — not a narrow, single-skill position
  • Real input into equipment upgrades and manufacturing improvement projects
  • Work within an established, well-resourced manufacturing operation

job.description:
A well-established commercial construction specialist based in Sydney CBD is seeking an experienced Project Manager to join their growing team.

With over 20 years in the Australian construction industry, this business has built a reputation on delivering high-quality commercial fit-outs, refurbishments and new builds — from education and healthcare facilities to sports precincts, hospitality fit-outs and corporate offices.

About the Role
As Project Manager, you'll take ownership of commercial construction projects from initial estimating and planning through to handover, leading a dedicated project team and ensuring every job is delivered on time, on budget and to an exceptional standard.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage the full project lifecycle across commercial fit-out, refurbishment and new build projects
  • Develop and maintain project programs, budgets and procurement schedules
  • Lead and coordinate site teams, subcontractors and consultants
  • Liaise directly with clients, architects and stakeholders to ensure expectations are met
  • Oversee quality, safety (OH&S) and environmental compliance on site
  • Identify and manage project risks, variations and commercial outcomes
  • Report on project progress, budgets and forecasts to senior management
About You
  • Proven experience as a Project Manager within commercial construction (fit-out, refurbishment or new build)
  • Strong understanding of construction methodology, programming and budgeting
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • A collaborative, hands-on approach with a genuine focus on client outcomes
  • Relevant trade, construction management or engineering qualifications preferred
  • Current driver's license and right to work in Australia
What's on Offer
  • Join a highly regarded, award-winning business (Master Builders Australia National Business Excellence Award winner)
  • Work on a diverse and interesting project portfolio
  • Supportive, close-knit team culture with a strong emphasis on integrity and quality
  • Genuine career progression within a growing company
To Apply
Please submit your resume to Miles@designandbuild.com.au or click 'APPLY'
